_meta.notes: Phase 3A survival model improvement (NB07). True baseline 0.514 (Cox PH, all-injury). Pre-tracking NB07 improvements (arm-only event, stratified Cox, elastic-net, GBSA addition) achieved 0.5559 best C-index as of 2026-06-19. Round S-001 established this as the formal starting point and added stochastic GBSA (subsample=0.8) achieving 0.5591 — delta +0.0032 < 0.005 → consecutive_non_improvements=1.
